request.prompt: Create exactly ONE isolated complete full-body figure of adult asari Samara wearing her canonical BLACK AND GOLD LOYALTY OUTFIT from Mass Effect 2, using the supplied multi-angle model reference sheet as the controlling source. Reproduce the SECOND figure in the TOP ROW: neutral standing pose, three-quarter front view facing toward image right, both relaxed arms down and slightly away from the torso, both hands and both full boots visible. The other figures are corroborating views of that exact same model, not extra subjects to include. Match the original adult proportions, blue-gray skin, stern recognizable face, crest shape, gold forehead ornament, circular patterned gold collar, tall black standing lapels, black fitted full-length outfit with fine gold trim following the exact torso seams, open upper-chest construction as shown, black shoulder guards, fine textured gray-black abdominal and thigh panels, long sleeves and gloves with small gold finger details, fitted black knee panels, tall black segmented shin boots with fine gold studs and modest original heels. Maintain the exact observed black/gold palette and panel topology. Do not invent or alter costume parts, proportions, jewelry, patterns or symbols; do not use the red default costume or a redesign. Conservative faithful in-game texture shading, crisp HD prerendered game character look with natural materials; no beauty retouch, exaggerated anatomy, fashion editorial treatment or added gloss. Entire single figure from crest tip to bottom of both soles, at least 10 percent empty margin on every side. Genuine transparent alpha background, with no cream background from the sheet, no floor, no cast shadow, no pedestal, no label, no caption, no frame, no logo, no weapon, no biotic effects and no duplicate views. This is a static visual prototype based on the supplied source, not a certification of in-engine materials or animation.
